body_markdown:
*Anyone can now use Embedder's AI platform for embedded software development on personal, educational, and non-commercial projects, at no cost. Embedder Free launches alongside Hackster.io.*


**SAN FRANCISCO, Oct. 14, 2026**


Embedder, an AI startup building the world's first autonomous firmware engineer, today launched Embedder Free, a new plan that gives anyone access to its enterprise AI platform for embedded software development at no cost. Embedder Free is launching alongside[Hackster.io](https://www.hackster.io/) , home to one of the largest communities of hardware and embedded developers.


Whether you're bringing up your first board or you've been shipping firmware for years, Embedder Free is an invitation to see what AI can do on real hardware, at your own pace.


## Why we built it


General-purpose coding assistants struggle with firmware. They invent register names, call SDK functions from the wrong chip family, and have no way to check their work on a device. We documented these patterns in detail in[Where LLMs go wrong in firmware](https://embedder.com/news/where-llms-go-wrong-in-firmware-a-field-guide-to-failure-modes) .


Embedder was built to close that gap. It grounds its work in the datasheets, reference manuals, and schematics for your hardware, and it connects to your board to flash builds, inspect device state, and debug failures until the code actually runs.


We believe the next chapter of embedded development is an exciting one. Engineers get more room to think like system architects, experiment freely, and use AI to help build, test, and iterate. We want the whole embedded community to experience that shift with us, and the best way to understand it is to get hands-on.


## What's included


Embedder Free is designed for individual developers exploring Embedder on their own projects. It includes:


- Access to the Embedder agent as a single user
- Support for select[hardware platforms](https://docs.embedder.com/supported-hardware/) , schematic formats, and AI models
- Free credits, up to a usage limit
- Email and community support, including our[Discord](https://discord.gg/HDtaYh6WbE)


Embedder Free is for personal, educational, and non-commercial projects. Start building with[Embedder](https://app.embedder.com/) today.
